_about: A starting checklist for AI-generated stills and clips. Copy it into your project, delete what doesn't apply, and add one item for every fault a reviewer names. Each item: one yes/no question, when it fails, and how to fix it.

still.q: Does any person have extra or missing limbs, an extra arm or hand, fused or duplicated bodies, a melted face, or warped hands?
still.fix: re-roll; if one small figure, crop or blur it

still.q: Look at every person whose feet are off the ground. Is the height plausible for a real jump, are the legs bent for take-off or landing, and is there a shadow directly below them? Is every standing or walking person's foot on the ground with a contact shadow?
still.fix: describe feet planted and the shadow under them; regenerate from words

still.q: Is there any readable text, letters, numbers, logo, crest, badge or brand mark anywhere (clothes front and back, signs, boards, screens, objects)?
still.fail_if: any mark that reads as text, a number or a logo
still.fix: describe the surface as plain and smooth; blur small marks; re-roll if large

still.q: Does anyone look cut out and pasted in: wrong scale for where they stand, wrong lighting, no shadow, edges that don't sit in the scene?
still.fix: regenerate the whole frame from words (no edit that adds people)

still.q: Looking at the faces you can make out, is there a real mix of ethnicities, not all or nearly all one?
still.fail_if: everyone, or nearly everyone, visible is one ethnicity when a mix was asked for
still.fix: describe the nearest faces one by one with heritage; give the crowd a stated mix

still.q: If a REFERENCE image was given, does the matching subject (place, character, product) match it?
still.fix: attach the reference and describe its key features; re-roll

still.q: Does anything look like a real brand, logo, club, product or famous place?
still.fix: describe it as plain and invented; re-roll

still.q: Is anything else physically wrong: impossible geometry, duplicated people side by side, objects melting or merging, things hanging in the air for no reason?
still.fix: re-roll with the fault described away positively

clip.q: Does any person, face, limb or object morph, melt, split, merge, duplicate or change identity during the clip?
clip.fix: fewer movers; keep the crowd still; re-roll

clip.q: Does anything jump position between frames, appear from nowhere or vanish?
clip.fix: keep objects still or out of frame; cut on a reaction

clip.q: Do people's feet stay on the ground when they walk or run (no gliding, sliding or floating)?
Does readable text, a number or a logo appear at any point?
clip.fix: blur in the edit or re-roll

clip.q: Is the camera motion smooth and believable, without warping the scene or the people?
clip.fail_if: the set warps or the camera jerks
clip.fix: lock the camera and add the move in the edit

clip.q: Is anything else physically wrong (smoke, fire, liquids, a ball with no physics)?
clip.fix: keep it out of frame or still; re-roll
